description: FREE. Request custom data from HSH Intelligence Data-on-Demand: describe the need in plain language and give a valid work email (contact_email, required). Our team reviews every custom request and emails you a quote; no price or payment link is returned here. This is also how to request a custom dataset or a fine-tuning dataset.

agent_id.description: Optional calling-agent or wallet identifier, so we can recognise you if you return.

budget_usd.description: Optional budget in USD, passed to our team.

contact_email.description: REQUIRED. A real work email address. Requests without a valid, deliverable work email are not taken; reserved, test and disposable domains are refused. Our quote is sent here.

need.description: Free-text description of the data you need (type, volume, geography, freshness).

name: hsh_describe_data_need
